# Aurora Filtech Co., Ltd (www.aurora-filtech.com)
> Industrial Filter Fabrics, Paper Machine Clothing (PMC), Spiral Fabrics & Mesh Belts Manufacturer. 30+ years experience, 3 factories in China & UK office, in-house monofilament extrusion, German Dornier weaving looms, laser cutting & automated seaming. OEM/ODM worldwide.

## Core Products
- [Forming Fabric (Forming Wire)](https://www.aurora-filtech.com/forming-fabric/): 1-layer, 1.5-layer, 2-layer and 3-layer SSB polyester forming wires for paper machines, nonwoven lines and flexible graphite sheet forming.
- [Dryer Fabric (Dryer Belt)](https://www.aurora-filtech.com/dryer-fabric/): Anti-static dryer belts (12804TK, 16804K), 4106S silicone-coated belts for MDF/OSB board lines, wool scouring dryer belts, and flat-yarn paper dryer fabrics.
- [Spiral Fabric (Spiral Belt)](https://www.aurora-filtech.com/spiral-belt/): SP-D open spiral dryer fabrics (up to 1016 CFM, no filler yarns) and SP-P filled spiral press filter belts (2–5 round or flat filler yarns, down to 325 CFM) in PET, PPS, hydrolysis-resistant and PTFE-added grades.
- [Vacuum Filter Fabric](https://www.aurora-filtech.com/vacuum-fabric/): Woven monofilament & satin filter belts for horizontal vacuum belt filters (HVBF), rotary drum and disc filters (FGD gypsum, mining concentrates, alumina, phosphoric acid).
- [Press Filter Fabric](https://www.aurora-filtech.com/press-fabric/): Chamber, frame and membrane filter press cloths in PET, PP, PA66 (nylon) and PVA, laser-cut with reinforced necks and eyelets.
- [Press Filter Belt](https://www.aurora-filtech.com/press-belt/): Herringbone and satin woven dewatering belts for belt filter presses in municipal sewage, paper mill sludge, coal washing and fruit juice pressing.
- [Polyester Square Mesh](https://www.aurora-filtech.com/products/square-mesh/): Plain-weave 1/1 PET monofilament square mesh (400–2100 µm standard belts, 40–200 mesh sifting cloth) for wood panel drying, food dehydration and WPC wood flour classification.
- [Dust Collector Filter Bags](https://www.aurora-filtech.com/products/filter-bag/): Non-woven needle felt filter bags in PET, PPS, Nomex, P84, Acrylic and PTFE membrane laminates.
- [Industrial Filter Cartridges](https://www.aurora-filtech.com/products/filter-cartridge/): Pleated dust, air, water and oil filter cartridges (anti-static, PTFE-membrane, cellulose, PPS/Nomex).
